output: rmarkdown::html_vignette

  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Task-modulated covariance overview}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}

---

The covariance workflow estimates a matrix of task-modulated residual
cross-products for each psychological regressor. This is distinct from a
conventional seed-by-task PPI regression coefficient. The latter is described
in the Conventional PPI and gPPI vignette.

```{r}
library(multiPPI)
set.seed(31)
n <- 120L
X <- cbind(intercept = 1, task = rep(c(0, 1), length.out = n))
Y <- matrix(rnorm(n * 4), nrow = n)
fit <- mppi_fit(Y, X, psych_idx = 2, scale = "cov")
mppi_get_M(fit, 1)
```

The matrix is descriptive. Significance tests for covariance modulation require
a null procedure matched to the cross-product outcome; unsupported legacy
permutation options fail closed. `mppi_evidence(fit)` summarizes task-main-effect
fit, not evidence for covariance modulation or conventional PPI. Group and
adaptive-selection procedures require their own qualifications.
